verdict.rationale: Jira only claims generic 'Rich APIs' and community members mention using its REST API/JQL for scripting, and there is an official Atlassian MCP server, but no concrete official SDK (language libraries, client packages) is documented, and openapi.json/llms.txt discovery probes both 404 showing weak formal API surface for build-time tooling. missing for 10: documented official SDK packages (e.g. Python/JS/Java client libraries), working OpenAPI spec, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage beyond raw REST calls.
